## Definition of Done (Project Document, Table 15)

- [ ] Every acceptance criterion this change covers has been demonstrated
- [ ] No commented-out code, debugging output, or unfinished markers
- [ ] Unit tests cover the new logic, and every new or changed endpoint has an integration test
- [ ] CI is green on this pull request
- [ ] Walked end to end by someone other than the author
- [ ] Checked at 360px and 1280px widths in at least two browsers
- [ ] Keyboard operable, labeled fields, alternative text, AA contrast
- [ ] No credentials, keys, or connection strings in the change; server-side input validation on new endpoints
- [ ] README or interface notes updated if setup or behavior changed
- [ ] Hours logged for this work

## Reviewer

One approving review from a member who did not write the change is required before merge.
